v1.44.0b (9 December 2024) |feed_title = Small Update |feed_color = Orange |previous_update = [[v1.43.0]] |next_update = [[v1.45.0]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.44.0''' is the ninety-seventh update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 4th of December 2024. It contained a few balancing changes for towers. This update encompassed three updates, the main v1.44.0 update (released 4 December 2024) and two minor updates, the v1.44.0a (released 7 December 2024) and v1.44.0b (released 9 December 2024). ==Removals== ===Enemies=== :Multiple enemies were removed as they were part of the [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]]. *[[Noob]] *[[Guest]] *[[Troll]] *[[Trader]] *[[Dev]] *[[Cat]] *[[Alien (Pls Donate)|Alien]] *[[UFO (Pls Donate)|UFO]] *[[Corrupted Haz3mn]] ===Maps=== :One map was removed as it was part of the [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]]. *[[Pls Donate]] ===Miscellanous=== *[[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Trapper]] buffed. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|550}} to {{Money|500}}. ****Spike firerate decreased from 5.525 to 5.275. ****Lifespan increased to 75 for all traps. ***'''Level 1''' ****Spike firerate changed from {{Tooltip|5.525 > 5.025|-0.5}} to {{Tooltip|5.275 > 5.025|-0.25}}. ***'''Level 2''' ****Spike damage decreased from +20 to +5. ****Spike health increased from +20 to +40. ****Landmine firerate decreased from 7.025 to 5.025. ****Explosion range increased from 3 to 5. ***'''Level 3''' ****Spike firerate changed from {{Tooltip|5.025 > 4.025|-1}} to {{Tooltip|5.025 > 7.525|+2.5}}. ****Spike health increased from +25 to +140. ****Spike damage decreased from +25 to +0. ****Landmine firerate changed from {{Tooltip|7.025 > 6.025|-1}} to {{Tooltip|5.025 > 4.025|-1}}. ****Landmine damage decreased from +40 to +20. ****Burn time changed from 1 to 1 > 2. ****Burn damage increased from +0 to +2. ****Burn tick changed from 1 to 1 > 0.25. ****Explosion range changed from 3 > 4 to 5. ***'''Level 4''' ****Spike firerate changed from {{Tooltip|4.025 > 2.025|-2}} to {{Tooltip|7.525 > 6.025|-1.5}}. ****Spike health increased from +25 to +250. ****Spike damage decreased from +25 to +15. ****Landmine firerate changed from {{Tooltip|6.025 > 4.525|-1.5}} to {{Tooltip|4.025 > 2.025|-2}}. ****Landmine damage decreased from +75 to +60. ****Burn damage decreased from +4 to +2. ****Burn time changed from 3 > 8 to 2 > 5. ****Explosion range changed from 4 > 6 to 5 > 7. ****No longer drops defense. ****Bear trap firerate decreased from 7.525 to 3.525. ****Bear trap damage decreased from 400 to 300. *[[Gatling Gun]] buffed. **Statistical changes. ***'''Base''' ****Angle increased from 30 to 40. ***'''Level 3''' ****Damage increased from +4 to +5. ****Without [[Firerate Bug]], firerate changed from {{Tooltip|0.15 > 0.13|-0.02}} to {{Tooltip|0.15 > 0.12|-0.03}}, however, because of the bug the firerate is effectively the same without [[Firerate Buff]]s. ****Angle increased from +5 to +10. ***'''Level 4''' ****Damage increased from +6 to +10. ****Without [[Firerate Bug]], firerate changed from {{Tooltip|0.13 > 0.09|-0.04}} to {{Tooltip|0.12 > 0.09|-0.03}}, however, because of the bug the firerate is effectively the same without [[Firerate Buff]]s. ****Angle decreased from +5 to +0. ***'''Level 5''' ****Damage increased from +18 to +20. ****Angle increased from +5 to +10. ***'''Level 6''' ****Damage increased from +27 to +30. ****Angle decreased from +10 to +5. ****Cost decreased from {{Money|115,000}} to {{Money|100,000}}. *Enabled revives. *Fixed [[Pursuit]] Level 5A cost being {{Money|35,000}} instead of {{Money|45,000}}. *Partially fixed loss UI not disappearing when using revives and restarting, while it still has a chance to not disappear it does not happen every time anymore. *Fixed [[Four Seasons]] water being lower than it should be, which made it mostly hidden. :In '''v1.44.0a''': *[[Pursuit]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|1,200}} to {{Robux|1,500}}. *[[Commando]] gamepass taken offsale. :In '''v1.44.0b''': *'''Pls Defense Simulator''' no longer appears in [[Mission Quests]]. **Because of this, number of slots has decreased from four to three.
